text: Per-pixel state: colour + depth + certainty (+ hidden channels)
description: Certainty works like fabric-artwork's camera-reprojector (domegame/fabric-artwork/src/shaders/reproject-points.fs + reproject-normalize.fs). Previous pixels are splatted as points with a bilinear tent weight; the accumulated weight (alpha) is the coverage/certainty. Depth is accumulated as weighted inverse depth and normalised. Low certainty tells the net where to generate. Certainty could decay over time, so stale regions get re-imagined.

status.comment: State per pixel: colour + inverse depth (A), velocity + certainty (B), 4 hidden channels (C). Certainty from the splat's tent weight, decays per net tick toward a rest value (net.frag: rest + (c - rest) * 0.965^tau); the net sees certainty and validity as inputs.
